prior_summary: Peg-frame SE(3) action targets and two-frame attachment geometry make the lift/reorientation/transport chunk transform with a rigidly displaced held peg while retaining hole relation and Panda configuration.
applicable_conditions: Prefer when peg and TCP enter displaced together, two causal frames show a stable peg-to-TCP transform, the gripper remains closed, and the observed hole is still reachable.
termination_guidance: Hand off when the peg is approximately identity-oriented and centered above the hole with descent underway; the complete [1380,1500) insertion overlap is retained for a multi-chunk transition.
limitations: A peg observation is not contact truth. This policy is inappropriate after a drop or slipping grasp, and peg anchoring alone does not solve a large change in peg-to-hole relation, obstacle layout, or arm reachability.
